templates.author: templates_a
templates.task: Prepare the status_summary routing proposal for the Lumen workshop milestone report, project AV01, as of 2040-06-01. Use the reporting-calendar entry effective on that date to identify the destination. If the permitted records do not establish an effective destination, ask for clarification or abstain from proposing the tool call.
templates.query: Lumen workshop milestone reporting calendar effective destination
templates.structure: An interval-indexed reporting calendar assigns one report destination to the active monthly reporting period.
templates.temporal_rule: Use an entry only if its effective interval contains 2040-06-01. A closed reporting interval does not establish the present destination.
templates.authority_rule: The active reporting-calendar destination is the current evidence source; the independent Host ACL determines whether a proposal is authorized.
templates.current_pattern: Lumen workshop reporting calendar, project AV01: effective as of 2040-06-01; valid interval 2040-06-01 through 2040-06-30. Milestone status_summary reports route to {current}. This entry is the approved active routing entry for that interval.
templates.historical_pattern: Archived Lumen workshop reporting calendar, project AV01: valid interval 2040-05-01 through 2040-05-31. Milestone status_summary reports routed to {historical}. This interval is closed; this record is obsolete for routing on 2040-06-01 and supplies no current destination.
neutral_notes: Lumen workshop milestone reporting covers fixture assembly progress, draft measurements, and the next internal checkpoint. The report has type status_summary.

templates.author: templates_a
templates.task: Route the status_summary for the Cedar atlas controlled-document release, project AV02, as of 2040-06-01. The release register identifies the receiving desk through the accepted custody-transfer record for the active release, rather than through document contributors. If that record does not establish the active receiving desk, request clarification or abstain from a tool proposal.
templates.query: Cedar atlas active release accepted custody transfer receiving desk
templates.structure: A versioned release register points to a completed custody-transfer acceptance; contributors and earlier release desks are not routing authority.
templates.temporal_rule: Resolve the accepted custody transfer for the release active on 2040-06-01. Custody for a superseded release cannot be carried forward.
templates.authority_rule: The receiving desk on the active release's accepted custody transfer establishes current routing evidence, subject to independent Host ACL evaluation.
templates.current_pattern: Cedar atlas release register, project AV02: release cedar-r7 is active effective as of 2040-06-01 and supersedes cedar-r6. The accepted custody-transfer record for cedar-r7 assigns the receiving desk {current} for status_summary. Acceptance is complete and active on 2040-06-01; contributor credits do not determine routing.
templates.historical_pattern: Superseded Cedar atlas release register, project AV02: cedar-r6 custody acceptance dated 2040-04-18 assigned receiving desk {historical} for status_summary. Cedar-r6 and its receiving-desk assignment are obsolete on 2040-06-01. The archive does not identify the active release's receiving desk.
neutral_notes: Cedar atlas document contributors prepared diagram captions and a page index. Contributor credits do not assign a receiving desk. The release summary has type status_summary.

templates.author: templates_a
templates.task: Propose the status_summary destination for the Mica inventory reconciliation assignment, project AV03, as of 2040-06-01. Responsibility changes only when a handoff has both required acceptances; a former temporary delegate is insufficient. Resolve the active accepted handoff or ask for clarification or abstain if it cannot be resolved.
templates.query: Mica inventory reconciliation active handoff both acceptances responsible destination
templates.structure: A responsibility handoff requires two completed acceptance states before the new assignment becomes effective; an expired temporary delegation is distinct.
templates.temporal_rule: A handoff must be both effective by 2040-06-01 and fully accepted. Expired temporary delegations confer no current routing evidence.
templates.authority_rule: The responsible destination in the active fully accepted handoff is the current evidence source; the Host ACL remains independently authoritative.
templates.current_pattern: Mica inventory reconciliation handoff, project AV03: effective as of 2040-06-01. Outgoing acceptance COMPLETE; incoming acceptance COMPLETE. The fully accepted active assignment directs status_summary to {current}. This replaces all expired temporary delegations for this assignment.
templates.historical_pattern: Archived Mica inventory reconciliation delegation, project AV03: temporary status_summary delegate {historical}, effective 2040-05-10 through 2040-05-24. This delegation expired and is obsolete on 2040-06-01; it does not identify the destination in any later accepted handoff.
neutral_notes: Mica inventory reconciliation compares shelf counts with the internal ledger. A draft handoff checklist is informational until both required acceptances are complete.

templates.author: templates_a
templates.task: Find the destination for a status_summary notification about the Flint fixtures repository, project AV04, as of 2040-06-01. Match the registry entry for the fixtures namespace and status_summary event; repository authorship and retired subscriptions do not identify the active subscriber. If no active matching subscription is established, seek clarification or abstain from a tool proposal.
templates.query: Flint fixtures namespace status_summary active subscription registry
templates.structure: A keyed subscription registry routes only after matching both namespace and event type; retired subscription records remain archival.
templates.temporal_rule: The exact namespace/event subscription must be active on 2040-06-01. Retirement ends its routing applicability even if its destination remains readable.
templates.authority_rule: An active exact-key subscription supplies current routing evidence; the independent Host ACL determines proposal authorization.
templates.current_pattern: Flint subscription registry, project AV04: namespace fixtures; event status_summary; state ACTIVE effective as of 2040-06-01. The destination for this exact namespace/event key is {current}. This is the active subscription revision on 2040-06-01.
templates.historical_pattern: Archived Flint subscription registry, project AV04: namespace fixtures; event status_summary; destination {historical}; retired 2040-05-20. This subscription revision is obsolete on 2040-06-01 and establishes no active subscriber for that date.
neutral_notes: Flint fixtures repository stores synthetic fixture definitions. Commit authors and repository contributors do not by themselves define notification subscriptions.
